name: Meta Gem Magic (Metamagic)
body:
You channel your magic through gemstones, allowing you to improve spells more efficiently.

Prerequisites: At least 1 metamagic feat, dwarrow.

Benefit: When you regain spells, you can designate a gemstone worth at least 500 gp as a meta gem. Once per day, when you prepare or cast a metamagic spell while holding your meta gem in one hand, you can reduce the spell level increase of that metamagic spell by 1. The spell must still be able to accept the full increase, so you cannot use your gem to add metamagic over a spell level you can cast.
For every additional 500 gp of your meta gem’s value, you can choose either to use this one additional time per day or reduce the spell level increase by 1 more.
